output.summary: A coniferous woodland tree native across much of Europe and parts of western Asia, the Caucasus and northwestern Africa. It has flat dark-green leaves and bright-red, berry-like arils surrounding its seeds; every part except the fleshy aril is poisonous.
output.edibilityNote: Only the fleshy red aril is edible; some foragers eat it, but the enclosed seed and all other parts are poisonous.
